scenarios.name: Hero Section Display
scenarios.description: Verify the hero section displays product name, tagline, and primary call-to-action elements correctly (REQ-1)

steps.description: Load the MirDB product homepage in a browser
steps.context: User lands on the homepage via direct URL or referral

steps.description: Check that the hero section is prominently displayed at the top of the page
steps.context: Hero section should be immediately visible without scrolling

steps.description: Confirm product logo, name 'MirDB', and tagline 'Persistent Key-Value Store with Memcached Protocol' are displayed
Check for 'Get Started' primary CTA and 'View on GitHub' secondary CTA buttons
steps.context: Both buttons should be clickable and visually distinct

test_cases.expected: Hero section renders with product logo visible
Product name 'MirDB' is displayed in hero section
Tagline 'Persistent Key-Value Store with Memcached Protocol' is visible
'Get Started' button exists and is clickable
'View on GitHub' button exists and links to GitHub repository

scenarios.name: Key Features Section

steps.description: Navigate to the features/benefits section of the homepage
steps.context: Section should be accessible via scrolling or navigation

steps.description: Check that 3-4 feature cards are displayed with icons and descriptions
steps.context: Features: Memcached Protocol, Persistent Storage, High Performance, Easy Configuration

steps.description: Confirm each feature card contains accurate information about MirDB capabilities

test_cases.expected: Features section exists and is visible
3-4 feature cards are displayed
Feature card for Memcached Protocol compatibility exists with icon
Feature card for Persistent Storage with LSM Tree exists
Feature card highlighting Rust performance exists
Feature card for Easy Configuration exists

steps.description: Click the copy button and verify the command is copied to clipboard

test_cases.expected: Quick-start section exists on the page
Code snippet is displayed in a formatted code block
Copy-to-clipboard button is present near the code snippet
Code content is copied to clipboard with visual feedback
Basic usage code example is provided
Link to full documentation exists and is functional

scenarios.name: Accessibility Compliance
scenarios.description: Verify homepage meets WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility requirements (NFR-3)

steps.description: Verify text color contrast ratio is at least 4.5:1
Navigate through all interactive elements using keyboard only
steps.context: Tab, Enter, Space should work for navigation

steps.description: Check all images have descriptive alt text
Verify visible focus indicators on all interactive elements
steps.context: Users must be able to see focused element

steps.description: Verify page is navigable with screen reader

test_cases.input: Run color contrast check on body text
test_cases.expected: Color contrast ratio >= 4.5:1 for normal text

test_cases.input: Query all img elements for alt attribute
test_cases.expected: All images have non-empty alt text
All interactive elements are reachable via keyboard
Visible focus indicator appears on buttons when focused
Page has proper h1-h6 hierarchy without skipping levels
Page has appropriate ARIA landmarks (main, nav, footer)
No critical accessibility violations detected
